(Japanese: '''圧倒的不利...!''' ''Overwhelming Drawback...!'') is the fifth chapter of the [[Pokémon RéBURST]] manga.
==Plot==
[[Hilgreitz]] says that from the beginning, it was impossible for [[Ryouga]] to defeat him, causing Ryouga to declare that there is no such thing as impossible to him. [[Miruto]] tells Ryouga to use {{type|Dragon}} attacks against Hilgreitz since he hasn't yet, as even though they are not very effective, they can still do damage. Ryouga admits that he doesn't know how to use any Dragon-type attacks, which surprises Miruto. Before Hilgreitz can attack again, [[Tougo]] appears, having finally scaled the mountain with the help of his {{p|Galvantula}}. The sight of the two [[Burst]] users scares him, as he thinks they are monsters. An annoyed Hilgreitz fires an attack at him. 

Ryouga manages to save Tougo, quickly grabbing him and leaping out of the way of the attack to hide with him and Miruto. At this point, Tougo recognizes Ryouga and offers to help him defeat Hilgreitz. Ryouga accepts his offer, much to Tougo's dismay, who seems to not have expected Ryouga to agree and becomes very anxious. With the help of Galvantula's {{m|String Shot}}, Ryouga is able to grab and launch a large boulder at Hilgreitz, but it is easily destroyed with a drill attack. This turns out to have been a distraction as Ryouga launches himself at Hilgreitz with a slingshot made of Galvantula's silk strung between two boulders. Ryouga uses the momentum to deliver a powerful claw attack to Hilgreitz, downing him.

==Major events==
* With the help of [[Tougo]], [[Ryouga]] deals a powerful blow to [[Hilgreitz]].
